official_immigration_source_name: Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Bangladesh – C-3-9 Tourist Visa Documents
review_notes: The Korean Embassy in Dhaka publishes a C-3-9 tourist visa checklist for Bangladesh applicants. From 4 May 2025, applicants complete the Korea Visa Portal e-form, print the barcode and personally submit the physical passport and supporting documents at the Embassy; this is not an eVisa. The Embassy checklist requires passport validity of at least 6 months, a valid air-ticket booking slip, cover letter, itinerary, accommodation reservation, personal bank statement and bank solvency certificate for at least six months, plus business, tax and employment evidence where available. Fees: USD40 single under 90 days, USD70 double, USD90 multiple; Embassy exchange standard is USD1=BDT125 effective 1 July 2025. Fees are non-refundable. The current C-3-9 processing time is not stated. Primary-source designation is being repaired against the existing official Embassy record; no change to the visa policy.

passport_validity_rule: Passport must have at least 6 months validity from the date of arrival.
blank_passport_pages_rule: Follow the High Commission's current passport-page requirements.

yellow_fever_or_health_rule: SG Arrival Card with electronic health declaration is mandatory for arriving visitors within 3 days including arrival day; follow any separate current health notices.
transit_rule: SG Arrival Card is not required for transit or transfer without clearing immigration; entry visa is required if a Bangladeshi ordinary-passport holder enters Singapore. Check any Visa Free Transit Facility eligibility separately.
application_channel: Submit the online visa application through one of the High Commission of Singapore in Dhaka's authorised visa agents. Ordinary Bangladeshi passport holders must obtain an entry visa before arrival.
application_fee: BDT equivalent of SGD 30 per applicant, excluding the authorised agent's fee.
processing_time: At least 5 working days for complete applications, excluding submission day; some cases take longer.
required_documents: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity|Completed Form 14A|Letter of Introduction (LOI) from an eligible local contact in Singapore|Recent colour passport photograph|Photocopy of passport biodata page|Free SG Arrival Card with electronic health declaration, submitted within 3 days including arrival day|Additional documents if requested
official_immigration_source_name: High Commission of Singapore in Dhaka – Visa Application (updated 6 Oct 2026)
review_notes: The High Commission of Singapore in Dhaka's current 6 October 2026 guidance confirms ordinary Bangladeshi passport holders need an entry visa before arrival, submitted online through an authorised visa agent in Dhaka. The government fee is the BDT equivalent of SGD 30, excluding agent fee; complete applications take at least 5 working days. ICA's Bangladesh-specific page confirms the visa requirement and states approved applicants can obtain an e-Visa through the e-Service. The SG Arrival Card is free, is not a visa, and must be submitted within 3 days including arrival day; the e-Pass issued after arrival sets the permitted stay. The current period of stay is not tied to visa validity.
